title: Visible, reversible filters and sorting
summary: Make active filters and sort order visible, individually removable, resettable, and stable enough that users can understand why the result set changed.
problem: Hidden filters and ambiguous sort state make result changes appear random and are hard to recover from.
use_when: Users need to narrow or order a substantial result set
Multiple constraints may be active simultaneously
avoid_when: The dataset is small enough that filtering adds more complexity than value
rationale: Filters are part of query state and need visible consequences.
Reversibility encourages exploration without fear of losing context.

use_if: Users need to narrow or order a substantial result set
Multiple constraints may be active simultaneously
prefer_alternatives_if: A single simple search field is sufficient

requirements: Keep filter controls operable by keyboard and touch.
Do not hide active constraints solely inside a closed panel.
Show active filters near results or in a clear summary.
Provide clear-all when several filters can accumulate.
Preserve filter state during result-detail navigation when useful.
responsive: A collapsed mobile filter panel must still expose that filters are active.
